parts.text: Produce a paired revision of the current Gemini Supervisor architecture as one atomic three-deliverable package. Revise Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js together, and create one shared ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json that both are designed around for external file references and runtime path settings. Integrate the canonical ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json as the single active Step 3 evaluation dependency, using its evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr together as one parsed JSON object. Replace active dependencies on evaluation-tests.md and step-3-test-return-schema.md. Agents.md must not duplicate the contents of step-3-evaluation.json; instead, where Agents.md references any external file or artifact, it must point to the same shared Supervisor config file and name the relevant config key rather than hard-code an independent path. send-to-gemini.js must load the same Supervisor config file and resolve external paths from it. Preserve the existing procedure, return schemas, supervisory gates, transition semantics, run isolation, persistence behavior, and live-ground-truth verification requirements except where changes are required to integrate the shared config and Step 3 evaluation artifact. Return only response_type paired_revision using the current paired_revision schema, with complete non-truncated revised_agents_md, revised_program, and revised_source_config. The revised_source_config must be the complete JSON object intended for ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json. Do not return patches, ellipses, or partial files.
